# Unicure India Ltd — Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Excellence

> Unicure India Ltd is a premier WHO-GMP certified pharmaceutical manufacturing enterprise established in 1984. With 40+ years of operational excellence, 3 high-capacity manufacturing units in India, a portfolio exceeding 500+ formulations, and distribution in 20+ countries worldwide, Unicure is a trusted contract manufacturing partner to top Indian and multinational pharma brands.

## Canonical Website & Contact
- **Website**: https://unicureindialtd.vercel.app
- **Official Domain**: https://www.unicureindia.com
- **Corporate Office**: C-21, 22 & 23, Sector-3, Noida, Uttar Pradesh, 201301, India
- **Phone**: +91-120-4786786
- **Sales & Business Inquiries**: inquiries@unicureindia.com
- **Corporate Inquiries**: unicure@unicureindia.com

## Core Accreditations & Quality Certifications
- **WHO-GMP Certified**: World Health Organization Good Manufacturing Practices compliance across manufacturing lines.
- **ISO 9001:2015**: Quality Management System Certification.
- **ISO 14001:2015**: Environmental Management System Certification.
- **Drug Licences**: State FDA Approved Form 25 (non-biologicals), Form 28 (biological/schedule C/C1), and Form 26.
- **Regulatory Dossiers**: CTD and ACTD dossier support for international regulatory submissions.

## Manufacturing Infrastructure (3 Units)
- **Unit I (Noida Sector-3, UP)**: Mother plant established in 1984. Specializes in oral solids (tablets & capsules), oral liquids, dry syrups, and topical formulations.
- **Unit II (Roorkee, Uttarakhand)**: Dedicated high-volume pharmaceutical manufacturing unit serving domestic and global markets.
- **Unit III (Greater Noida, UP)**: State-of-the-art facility engineered to cGMP standards for large-scale contract manufacturing and sterile formulations.

## Product Formulations & Dosage Forms
- **Oral Solid Dosage**: Uncoated tablets, film-coated tablets, enteric-coated tablets, chewable tablets, dispersible tablets, effervescent tablets, hard gelatin capsules.
- **Oral Liquid Dosage**: Suspensions, syrups, oral solutions, dry syrups for pediatric reconstitution.
- **Topical Preparations**: Ointments, creams, gels, lotions.
- **Specialty Forms**: Eye/Ear drops, oral rehydration sachets, nutraceuticals, injectables.

## Business Verticals
- **Contract & Third-Party Manufacturing**: Turnkey formulation, bulk production, custom packaging, batch testing, and regulatory filing for third-party brands.
- **Global Pharmaceutical Exports**: Supplying finished dosages to over 20 countries in Africa, Southeast Asia, CIS, Latin America, and the Middle East.
- **Institutional & Government Supplies**: Qualified vendor for government healthcare tenders and international health organizations.
